title: a clean ubuntu:24.04 container installs and boots @mpd-dsh/mpd from a copy of this checkout
proves: node 24 + bun + pnpm + @deepseek-ai/dsh install inside a bare ubuntu:24.04 container
the bundle installs with ONE command from a copy of the checkout (dsh plugin --profile web add .)
every packages/*/dist entry rebuilds from source with the canonical repo-root bun build
a MOUNTING boot in an isolated HOME/DSH_HOME applies the plugin tree and registers the mpd tools
the official TeamService (@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-agent-team) is mounted in that process
the mpd session gate LISTENER is registered for a real mpd session (liveness, not composition)
the mpd preset really mounts: POST /api/session/create answers ok with agentPreset=mpd
provesCompositionOnly: the composed profile carries the mpd rows, the preset-mpd row and the three official agent-team rows
doesNotProve: any live LLM turn or model routing: no credentials are staged (AGENTS.md §10)
`--dump-config` output is COMPOSITION evidence and is never cited here as a plugin load
a machine without network access: apt, nodejs.org, bun.sh, npm and the registry are all used

assertions.reason: the base image is ubuntu:24.04

assertions.name: harness.version
assertions.reason: npm i -g then 'dsh --version' printed the pin exactly

assertions.reason: the build context carries no host state and no install-affecting config, so nothing can pass for a dependency the container should have installed

assertions.name: copy.repo

assertions.name: build.bunInstall
assertions.reason: not applicable in one-click mode: the published package carries its own dependencies and the install materializes them

assertions.name: build.dists
assertions.reason: not applicable in one-click mode: the published package ships its built dist entries, and the mount below is what judges them

assertions.name: install.exit
assertions.reason: one command installed the bundle into the profile

assertions.name: install.profileDep
assertions.reason: the profile records the GIT spec pnpm resolved — the published-package path, not a checkout link — and keeps the box bundles

assertions.name: install.installedTree
assertions.reason: the installed bundle resolves inside the profile

assertions.name: compose.dumpExit
assertions.reason: the sanctioned composer exited 0

assertions.name: compose.mpdRows
assertions.reason: the mpd host rows compose and the default preset selection is mpd

assertions.name: compose.presetRow
assertions.reason: the mpd preset is declared as a @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset row (§4 D1)

assertions.name: compose.agentTeamRows
assertions.reason: the official agent-team rows compose under the mpd-owned ids (§4 D3)

assertions.name: boot.probeApplied
assertions.reason: the probe plugin's apply() ran inside the booted harness — a real MOUNT, not a composition

assertions.name: boot.adapterService
assertions.reason: the mpd-dsh-adapter row applied and provided the mpdDsh service

assertions.name: boot.adapterToolCall
assertions.reason: an internal tool call through the adapter answered ok

assertions.name: boot.mpdTools
assertions.reason: every core mpd tool answered from the live registry

assertions.name: boot.agentTeamTools
assertions.reason: every official agent-team tool answered from an EXACT AGENT SCOPE after session creation (the plane the official plugin registers them in)

assertions.name: boot.sessionGateListener
assertions.reason: the mpd session gate listener is REGISTERED for the created session — liveness, not composition (the contract that was silently dead in v0.10.0)
assertions.raw: [mpd-roles] session gate listener registered for agent "session-e358a7b0-f87b-408d-a61f-5ce2a4982583" agentPreset=mpd

assertions.name: boot.agentTeamService
assertions.reason: the official TeamService is mounted in the booted process (its class name is the witness)

assertions.name: boot.servesHttp
assertions.reason: the booted Web app answered 200

assertions.name: boot.presetMount
assertions.reason: the gateway created a session with agentPreset=mpd — every row of the mpd preset activated (it refuses on an inactive row)

assertions.name: boot.noFatalSignatures
assertions.reason: no fatal apply/module signature in the boot log

assertions.name: isolation.home
assertions.reason: HOME and DSH_HOME stay on the sandbox paths for every harness command

assertions.name: isolation.realHome
assertions.reason: no harness/toolchain marker under the real home (/root)

assertions.name: isolation.noCredentials
assertions.reason: no credential file carries a secret-shaped value, and nothing was staged into the container in the first place (the empty .credentials.yaml the harness materializes in the SANDBOX home is expected)

assertions.name: tui.hostInstall
assertions.reason: the TUI host installs globally and lands on PATH

assertions.name: tui.pluginAddHost
assertions.reason: the TUI host bundle installs into the dsh-tui profile

assertions.name: tui.pluginAddBundle
assertions.reason: THIS bundle installs into the dsh-tui profile as the third patch layer

assertions.name: tui.compose
assertions.reason: dsh --profile dsh-tui --dump-config composes (COMPOSITION ONLY, never a load proof)

assertions.name: tui.registryDefaultMpd
assertions.reason: the TUI's OWN scoped registry row is id-targeted to the mpd preset (user decision D10 on the 0.1.7 row model)

assertions.name: tui.presetRow
assertions.reason: the mpd preset row is composed in the TUI plane

assertions.name: tui.mpdTuiRow
assertions.reason: the bundle's mpd-tui row is composed in the TUI plane

assertions.name: tui.agentTeamRows
assertions.reason: all three official Agent Teams rows are composed in the TUI plane

assertions.name: tui.boot
assertions.reason: the REAL TUI booted on a real PTY and reached its chat screen

assertions.name: tui.noFatalSignatures
assertions.reason: no fatal apply/module/preset signature in the TUI pane or log

assertions.name: tui.sessionPreset
assertions.reason: the session the TUI created records agentPreset=mpd (the D10 default, read from the harness's own store)

assertions.name: boot.llmTurn
assertions.reason: not attempted: a live LLM turn needs provider credentials and this container stages none (AGENTS.md §10). The mount assertions above are the credential-free maximum.

assertions.name: oneclick.scratchRepo
assertions.reason: the scratch remote (a git repository of the build context) exists, so the spec resolves through the real git path

assertions.name: oneclick.requiredPaths
assertions.reason: every path the rows and the display metadata name is present in the installed package
assertions.raw: checked: patch files, MCP launchers, web client, icon, locale, skills corpus

assertions.name: oneclick.filesAllowlist
assertions.reason: the files allowlist was honoured: no frozen evidence tree, no git history, no lane scratch in the installed package

assertions.name: oneclick.distByteIdentical
assertions.reason: 27 committed dist entry/entries landed byte-identical, so the install ran no build and shipped what the source tree builds

assertions.name: tui.laneExit
assertions.reason: the TUI lane ran to completion with every assertion green
